en: Dig, dig, dig! For 500 Watts I'll dig you up whatever's down there. Could be something good! You have {var:VAR_GALAR_WATTS} W.
There you go! The ground's always got something for those who ask it nicely.
That's not 500 Watts, friend. Touch a den's beam of light and you'll have plenty.
Suit yourself! The ground's not going anywhere.
